acknowledged.detail: Backlot accepts it; the vendor's spec declares no such parameter
acknowledged.note: Measured against slack.com on 2026-09-06: the real Web API reads an argument from the QUERY STRING on a POST exactly as it reads one from the form body. `POST chat.getPermalink` with no arguments answers `invalid_arguments`; with `channel` and `message_ts` in the query string it answers `channel_not_found`, the same answer it gives with them in the body. The vendor's spec documents only the body location, which is the spec being incomplete rather than Backlot inventing a parameter. Backlot reads every argument query-or-form through `_param`, so a client written against either location works against both.

Out of scope until a corpus can say what a Grid org is.
